review_candidates.title: Product Owner
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The PO is responsible for defining product vision, prioritizing the backlog, and ensuring the team delivers maximum business value. Responsibilities: • Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and roadmap. • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and business requirements. • Collaborate with the Scrum Master and development team to clarify and refine requirements. Requirements Qualifications & Skills: Education: • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field
